analysis.reasonEn: Despite falling for 4 sessions after the previous buy signal (RSI exiting oversold + CCI extreme recovery), RSI attempts to break out of oversold at 39.8. MACD histogram improved from -2.9992 to 0.0383, signaling bottoming. Current price ($323.40) is above the 5-day low ($319.30), indicating potential for a Higher Low pattern. Expecting a rebound near the lower Bollinger Band ($312.95).

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($323.40) vs SMA5 ($338.34)/SMA20 ($345.56)/SMA50 ($352.49): Below, confirming short-to-medium term downtrend.
· Significant distance below SMA100 ($370.14)/SMA200 ($366.62): Weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (16.3%): Attempting a bounce near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (34.3→39.8): Attempting to exit oversold, weak recovery momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.9992→0.0383): Shifting from bearish convergence to improvement, signaling bottoming.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $312.95): Approaching lower band, potential for technical bounce.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($321.42): Near current price, short-term support expected.
· Swing Resistance ($339.99): Breakout could confirm trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Above 5-day low, potential Higher Low formation, needs confirmation against 20-day low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.04x): Average level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis: Technical bounce within a downtrend, considering buy entry due to RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement signals.
